name: mapleidle-guild-analysis
description: Top 50 guild score analysis for Bera 1 and Bera 2, built from mapleidle.gg

scripts.scrape: SERVER=bera-1 EXTRA=Freaky,Zerua node scrape.mjs && SERVER=bera-2 node scrape.mjs
scripts.build: SERVER=bera-1 node build.mjs && SERVER=bera-2 node build.mjs && node pack.mjs && node make.mjs
scripts.verify: SERVER=bera-1 GUILDS=Snooze,Grace,Freaky,Zerua node verify2.mjs && SERVER=bera-2 GUILDS=Westhelm,Degens,Riot node verify2.mjs && node verify3.mjs
scripts.refresh: npm run scrape && npm run build && npm run verify && npm run check
